ns2:course.label: Organ Literature
ns2:course.description: Intensive study of organ literature from Bach to the present; includes the music itself, recordings, and collateral readings. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in music or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in music or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Music department.
